final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS a, tr.tradekind AS b, AVG(s.anlycount) AS c FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref COLLATE BINARY = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref COLLATE BINARY = tr.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.a AS a, s1.b AS b, s1.c AS c, s1.c - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT b AS k, AVG(c) AS avgc, AVG(d) AS avgd FROM s3 GROUP BY b), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(avgc) AS m FROM s4) SELECT s4.k, s4.avgc, s4.avgd, s4.avgc / s5.m AS ratio FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.m IS NOT NULL
